existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing website for “Legend Techno Solutions” focused on computer repair, laptop repair, CCTV installation, and networking services, with clear navigation and calls-to-action.

Implement a coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, components) suitable for a technical repair/services brand, and apply it consistently across all pages/sections (avoid default template look).

Add a Services section/page that clearly presents service categories: Computer Repair, Laptop Repair, CCTV Installation, and Networking, each with a short description and a simple “Request Service” CTA linking to the Contact form.

Add an About section/page describing Legend Techno Solutions and its service coverage, including a concise value proposition and a small list of differentiators (e.g., fast turnaround, genuine parts, on-site support) using neutral, non-claimy wording.

Create a Contact page/section with a form that captures: name, phone/email, service type (select), message/issue description, and preferred contact method; validate inputs on the client and show success/error states.
Add a simple Admin page in the frontend that displays stored contact inquiries in a table/list, with basic client-side filtering by service type and most-recent-first sorting.
Integrate required generated brand images as static assets (served from frontend/public/assets/generated) and use them in the header/hero and favicon/app icon where appropriate.
Replace the current Legend Techno Solutions logo image with a new logo design, and update all frontend references so the new logo is used wherever the old logo appears (site header and footer).
Replace the current favicon/app icon with a new version that matches the updated logo, and update the HTML metadata references accordingly.
Add the uploaded logo image as a static asset in the frontend and use it as the primary Legend Techno Solutions logo wherever the current logo is displayed (site header and footer).
Add the user-uploaded logo image to the frontend as a static asset and update all logo usages so the site header and footer display the new uploaded logo instead of the current generated logo asset.
Update the site’s displayed contact phone number to 7019071669 wherever a phone number is shown in the UI (including the Contact section’s Contact Information card).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an app/site for Legend Techno Solutions (computer/laptop repair and CCTV/networking services).

Update site-wide contact phone number to 7019071669 (display wherever contact info appears).
